business_impact.basis: COPQ calculator Q2 2026 total ($7,742) x 4 -- labeled projection, Q2 actuals x4 basis stated

goal.statement: Cut mean routine-ticket resolution time to at most 8.0 business hours by 2026-10-31, without degrading the reopen-rate or tech-overtime guardrails.

artifact.notes: Problem statement is magnitude-only (no cause, no fix); risks include the fall onboarding surge and approval-policy pushback.

magnitude.unit: business hours average resolution time, routine (P3) tickets

problem_statement.what: Routine (P3) help-desk tickets take far longer to resolve than the published service-catalog promise.
problem_statement.when: Ongoing through 2026; June 2026 spot-pull and the July 2026 baseline window both confirm it.
problem_statement.where: Harborview Mutual internal IT help desk (~380-person regional insurance office).

process_owner.name: Naomi Castillo
process_owner.role: Help desk lead -- runs the daily triage and dispatch

risks.mitigation: Declare the confound before the window opens; read its direction on the proof honestly
risks.risk: Fall onboarding class of 14 new hires starts 2026-09-21, inside the after window, and can only push access-grant volume (and resolution times) up

risks.mitigation: Queue the access matrix as a second, later pilot rather than bundling it with the dispatch-rule change
risks.risk: Approval-policy pushback on any pre-approved access matrix change

scope.in_scope: Routine (P3) tickets: password resets, software installs, access grants, open-to-confirmed-resolution.
scope.out_scope: P1/P2 incidents, project work, and any ticket outside the routine queue.
